request.style: English, young boy voice, acoustic guitar, piano, flute, cello, tambourine, gentle and hopeful, 100 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Josiah was young when he became king
He did what was right in the Lord's sight
In his twelfth year he began to cleanse
Idols and images cast to the dust
He tore down the altars of Baal
And scattered the dust over the graves
He burned the bones of the priests
And cleansed Judah and Jerusalem

[Chorus]
He humbled himself before the Lord
Tore his clothes and wept in sorrow
He heard the words of the Law
And sought the God of Israel

[Verse]
Hilkiah found the Book of the Law
Hidden in the house of the Lord
Shaphan brought it to the king
And read the words in his presence
When the king heard the Law's command
He tore his clothes in great distress
He sent messengers to Huldah
The prophetess in Jerusalem

[Chorus]
He humbled himself before the Lord
Tore his clothes and wept in sorrow
He heard the words of the Law
And sought the God of Israel

[Bridge]
Disaster comes upon this place
Because they forsake the Lord
But you are gathered to your fathers
Your eyes will not see the end
Your heart was tender and humble
Weeping before God's holy face

[Verse]
The king gathered all the elders
Priests and Levites stood in line
He read the Book of the Covenant
From the greatest to the least
He made a pledge to follow God
With all his heart and all his soul
To keep the commandments and statutes
Written in the book they found

[Chorus]
He humbled himself before the Lord
Tore his clothes and wept in sorrow
He heard the words of the Law
And sought the God of Israel

[Outro]
Josiah cleansed the land of sin
And renewed the covenant
Walking in the ways of David
Seeking the God of Israel
